title.en: An Act Creating Certain Barrios in the Province of Marinduque
title.orig: An Act Creating Certain Barrios in the Province of Marinduque

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1961/ra_3391_1961.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sitios of Kay Duque, Mabuhay, Dampulan and Talawan in the Municipality of Torrijos, Province of Marinduque, are converted into barrios to be known as the barrios of Kay Duque, Mabuhay, Dampulan and Talawan, respectively.
The sitio of Bambangalon in the Municipality of Boac, same province, is hereby converted into a barrio to be known as the barrio of Bambangalon.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1961.
